HEADLINE: R81 did not fail for want of data, so no dataset can unblock it. The certified information is sufficient and free; the binding constraint is the number of TRADABLE INSTRUMENTS the mechanism can address. That makes this a NOT_A_PURCHASE_CANDIDATE and an execution-representation question, not an information question.

the_chain: The mechanism ranks ECONOMIES by a non-price terms-of-trade measure.
An economy is expressible in this estate only as its currency future on the R38 certified dated-contract layer.
That layer contains exactly EIGHT currency futures: 6A, 6B, 6C, 6E, 6J, 6M, 6N, 6S.
Measured: MDE_80 is NOT REACHED for the 8-market cross-section even at an injected information coefficient of 0.20, which is 4-10x any plausible cross-sectional macro IC (0.02-0.05).
Therefore a dataset covering 40 economies with perfect point-in-time vintages would still be ranked into at most 8 tradable legs, and would still fail the same gate by the same margin.
WHY_A_PURCHASE_CANNOT_FIX_IT.the_one_line: Buying wider INFORMATION does not widen the INSTRUMENT SET, and the instrument set is the wall.
WHY_A_PURCHASE_CANNOT_FIX_IT.corroboration: The same wall appears with a SYNTHETIC signal of known strength, and the unmodified 28-market control panel detects IC 0.20 at 20 of 20. The null is a property of the cross-section, not of the signal or the harness.

PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_1_economic_mechanism: SATISFIED. Terms-of-trade pass-through to the real exchange rate, one named channel, sign declared a priori.
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_2_cheap_proxy: FAILS THE PURCHASE, SATISFIES THE ESTATE. The free proxy is not merely adequate, it is CERTIFIED: FRED/ALFRED import-price-by-origin vintages, 8,703 records, 0 clamped, earliest vintage 2010-03-16, 16.3 years, $0. A purchase must beat a free certified dataset, and there is nothing to beat.
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_3_marginal_evidence: FAILS. No dataset adds marginal evidence, because the evidence ceiling is set by 8 instruments x 187 monthly decisions, not by information content.
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_4_exact_data_gap: NO DATA GAP EXISTS. The gap is an instrument gap. Stating a dataset here would misname the defect.
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_5_point_in_time: ALREADY SATISFIED FREE. True ALFRED realtime_start per observation; publication lag measured at median 13 days, p95 17 (n=3,152).
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_6_survivorship_inactive: NOT APPLICABLE to a macro index family; no delisted-name dimension exists.
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_7_sample_evaluation: DONE AND DECISIVE: 196 monthly non-overlapping decision periods, 187 on the book's own 21-session grid. This is the WHOLE archive; the family is published monthly so no purchase can raise the decision count.
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_8_incremental_backtest: REFUSED BY GATE B BEFORE MEASUREMENT, per R66's on_failure rule. No candidate return was scored, so no incremental backtest exists and none may be quoted.
PURCHASE_GATE_EVALUATION.condition_9_economic_value: CANNOT BE ESTABLISHED. An effect large enough to clear MDE_80 here (IC >= 0.15) is not a plausible prior for a monthly macro signal, so expected value cannot be argued from evidence.

THE_ACTUAL_MISSING_CAPABILITY.name: A WIDER TRADABLE FX CROSS-SECTION WITH A CANONICAL COST MODEL
THE_ACTUAL_MISSING_CAPABILITY.what_it_is_not: It is not a dataset, not an entitlement and not a subscription.
THE_ACTUAL_MISSING_CAPABILITY.what_it_is: An execution-representation expansion: the ability to express a ranked cross-section of 20+ economies. On the owned estate that means FX instruments beyond the 8 CME currency futures - deliverable forwards or non-deliverable forwards for the EM economies the BLS already publishes origins for - each with a per-instrument cost model the canonical futures book can charge.
why_the_estate_cannot_provide_it_today: alpha_agent.agents_v2.books declares three books: EQUITY_TOPN, EQUITY_TRANCHE, FUTURES_DATED_CONTRACT. There is no FX spot or forward book, and no FX spot cost model.

Norgate 'Forex Spot' carries 57 symbols with full 2008-2026 history, so the PRICE side of a wider FX cross-section is already owned and free. What is absent is a certified cost model and an execution representation for it - a governed capability decision, not an acquisition.

Writing such a book is explicitly constrained by the no_duplicate_engine_rule in research/agents/governance_contract.json and would need its own certification and cost basis before any candidate could be scored on it.

expected_effective_sample_if_it_existed.decisions: 187 on the existing 21-session grid; unchanged, because the information is monthly
expected_effective_sample_if_it_existed.width_needed_for_MDE_80_at_a_plausible_I: the measured curve reaches 80% power at IC 0.10 only at ~27-38 markets; at IC 0.05 it does not reach 80% at ANY width measured up to 38
expected_effective_sample_if_it_existed.the_honest_reading: Even a 20-instrument FX cross-section would not clear MDE_80 at a plausible IC on 187 monthly decisions. Width alone is necessary but NOT sufficient. This axis is closed on power, not merely narrow.

WHAT_A_FUTURE_CAMPAIGN_MAY_AND_MAY_NOT_D.may_reuse_without_re_certifying: DATA_R81_D1_TERMS_OF_TRADE_VINTAGE_CERTIFICATION.json and configs/alpha_agent/stage2_terms_of_trade_vintage_backfill.json. The dataset is CERTIFIED_PIT, idempotent on re-run (verified: a second incremental run reports NO_NEW_SOURCE_DATA, 0 new records) and costs nothing.
may_not: Re-commission this cell on a currency cross-section. The MDE curve settles it and re-running it would spend a slot to learn a measured number again.

Widen the cross-section by inventing a regional basket weighting for ASEANTOT / ASNRETOT / INDUSTOT / LATTOT / OASTOT / PRIMTOT. Those origins have no single currency, and choosing weights after seeing the width constraint is finalising the construction in sight of the gate - the exact fault R66 refused.
File NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE for this cell. No return was ever scored.
WHAT_A_FUTURE_CAMPAIGN_MAY_AND_MAY_NOT_D.the_generalisation_that_should_travel: Any MONTHLY-published information family on this estate inherits this wall: at most ~196 decision periods, and a cross-section bounded by the tradable instruments the mechanism addresses. Before certifying the next monthly macro family, run the MDE curve FIRST - it is cheap, it needs no acquisition, and here it would have answered the campaign before a single record was downloaded.
